sheets.ledger: Ochre usual, green slow, blue in drops, very many. No red lines, nothing combed.
Blue drops, 1323, one at a time. Green slow, ochre as usual, seven red lines in the night, not combed.
Blue drops, eleven hundred and three, one at a time. Green slow, no red lines but three faint specks.
Ochre as usual, green steady. One red line at one o'clock, and blue drops over eleven hundred. Not combed.
Ochre usual, green slow, eighteen red lines in the small hours. Blue drops 1460, one at a time. Not combed.
Blue drops 1352, one at a time. Red lines thirteen, all in the small hours. Green slow, ochre as usual.
Ochre as usual, green slow but steady. Fifty red lines, mostly before dawn, and blue drops past eleven hundred.
Blue drops, over a thousand, unaccountable. Green slow, ochre as usual, nine red lines in the small hours.
Ochre as usual, green steady. A hundred red lines before dawn, and blue drops past twelve hundred. Not combed.
Ochre usual, green steady. Red lines 66, all in the night hours, and blue drops 818. Not combed.
Ochre as usual, green steady. Blue came in 58 drops, red only four lines in the evening, and no combing.
